title: Proposed common private process value representations v1
description: Definition-only helper module. The whole document rejects instances; consumers must reference a named definition with explicit UUID format assertion. Representation reuse grants no direction, object authority, secrecy, uniqueness, revision admission or checksum authenticity. Existing message schemas remain unchanged.

uuid.description: Lowercase hyphenated UUID text, without trimming, braces or URN prefix. UUID generation version, collision handling and issuer remain separate controls; this is not a bearer secret.

positive_revision.description: Positive exact binary64-safe integer as in the existing private preparation representation. Numeric shape does not prove a current revision, raw JSON lexical form or atomic admission.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex representation only. Hash algorithm execution, exact-byte correspondence, eligible source and authority remain independent checks; linkable values keep their privacy class.
